embeddedSource.method: Exact printable C-string beginning with #if defined(_SHADERBUILDER_DEBUG), extracted to its first NUL terminator. No source editing or reconstruction.
limits: Original Nu2 shader-builder template source, not directly compilable standalone HLSL without its pragma/preprocessing and feature-configuration pipeline.
Render-path selection still requires native shader builder analysis.

functions.name: lightingStage
functions.declaration: iNliNE void lightingStage( out half3 diffuseLight, out half3 specularLight )

limitations: Bytecode disassembly is not original HLSL. The embedded template is actual original text, with Nu2-specific preprocessing.
Function/pragma/macro catalogs are textual indexes; multiline declarations and conditional paths can require contextual reading.
No shader equivalence or Unity translation is claimed.
